Because a member of the recombination unit ($ $) is outcrossed, it passes on only single alleles to each offspring, y. This situation excludes all of the identity states except for $ _3 $ (both alleles in x are IBD, and one is passed on to the offspring y through $ $), $ _8 $ (the alleles in x are unrelated and one is passed onto y via $ $), and $ _9 $ (the alleles in x are unrelated to those in y).
